---
title: "ssoossh host"
description: "Manage local sshd principal mapping, and check sshd's setup."
---

<!-- Generated by genclidocs from the cobra command tree in client/cmd. Do not edit. -->

Configures the local principal mapping sshd consults through AuthorizedPrincipalsCommand: which certificate principals may log in as which local account. The mapping is a file on this host; nothing about it is stored on, or synced from, the server. Also checks that this host's sshd will accept ssoossh certificates.

## Synopsis

```
ssoossh host [command]
```

## Options

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--file` | string | `/etc/ssoossh/principals.yaml` | path to the local principal mapping file (YAML: local account -&gt; list of principals) |

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--config` | string |  | path to an extra config file, merged after the standard locations |
